name: Clockwork Arsenal
creator: Example Press
about: Wound-spring weapons, plated coats, a sparking cantrip and a brass hound, made up to show how licensed content is used.

records.name: Spring Pike
records.text: A pike whose head is driven forward by a wound spring in its haft.

records.name: Gearplate
records.text: Overlapping plates on a frame of small cogs that turn as the wearer moves.

records.name: Coil Spark
records.text: A spark jumps from a coil of wire in your hand to a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Lightning damage. The damage grows at levels 5, 11 and 17.

records.name: Brass Hound
records.text: A dog of riveted brass, wound by a key between its shoulders, that runs down whatever its keeper points at.

traits.name: Wound Down
traits.text: When the hound starts its turn with no one in sight, it settles and stops until it hears a sound.
